sql: SELECT obs_date, prcp_mm, snow_mm, tmax_c, tmin_c, CASE WHEN dayofweek(obs_date) = 5 THEN 'Thursday' ELSE NULL END AS weekday_name FROM whybot.nyc_weather_daily WHERE obs_date IN (DATE '2024-11-28', DATE '2024-11-07', DATE '2024-11-14', DATE '2024-11-21') ORDER BY obs_date LIMIT 500
